interval_rules: A targeted review set (e.g. the windows olmoearth_review_set lists) is not a sample: its error rate overstates the map's, 1.8 to 5.8 times on the package's exp78.

The simple-random-sample interval p +/- 1.96 sqrt(p(1 - p)/n) does not apply to a stratified or targeted design, nor to a pool of both; report the interval and method olmoearth_estimate_map_error returns instead.
result.report: Report the estimate with [low, high] and the method string as returned; the rate is of the design's population windows.
next_steps: Report the estimate with its interval and method as returned (the fact whole_map_estimate states them); the rate is of the design's population.

No zone can be certified from this confidence design: olmoearth_certify_zone needs design='random'. A certified zone needs a new plan with design='random', every drawn window labelled, and alpha, delta and rule fixed before labelling.
A narrower interval needs more labels under a new plan with a larger budget, fixed before any of its labels is seen.

This map's error rate is estimated at **19.4%**, 95% interval **15.7% to 23.6%** (from 300 labelled windows of a population of 15,813).

Method: stratified by confidence margin; Wilson interval on the design's effective sample size (effective n = 384.1). Overall accuracy estimate: 80.6%.

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Error rate | 19.4% |
| 95% interval | 15.7% – 23.6% |
| Effective n | 384.1 |

Note: because this is a confidence-stratified design, no certified zone can be drawn from these labels — that would require a separate `design='random'` plan. A narrower interval needs more labels under a new plan fixed before labelling.
